title: VERY curious how The Princess Bride is adapted, I have so many questi...
transcript: We are officially one step closer to the Princess Bride musical, and I cannot wait. Right now in New York, they are doing the workshop presentation for The Princess Bride, directed by Alex Timbers, written by Bobby Lopez and Kristen Anderson-Lopez, with a book by Rick Elice and Bob Martin, whose last collaboration was smash. But I, I, I, I have faith in them. I have faith in them. I do think adapting a film is much easier than adapting a two season T V. Series. Now, as with any workshop, the workshop cast is not necessarily the final cast, but we have some heavy hitting names. So on here are some names I'm really excited to see. Shout outs to Will Man ln and Marissa  Rosen, who I adore. A lot of the Hazbin Hotel team. I cannot believe this is finally happening and I cannot wait to see where they first stage it. This has been one of those musicals that's been in development hell for what feels like forever. So to finally see a workshop happening. Cannot wait, cannot wait.
classificationReason: Discussion of the Princess Bride musical workshop announcement. The show is not on the provided list, and no first-hand opinion of a live production is given.
